caseName: Akron, Canton & Youngstown Railroad v. Frozen Food Express
caseNameFull: AKRON, CANTON & YOUNGSTOWN RAILROAD CO. v. FROZEN FOOD EXPRESS
attorneys: Carl Helmetag, Jr. and Charles P. Reynolds for appellants in No. 258., Rollo E. Kidwell and Peter T. Beardsley for appellant in No. 263., Robert W. Cinnane and Charlie H. Johns, Jr. for appellant in No. 270., Carl L. Phinney for the Frozen Food Express, appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter and Mr. Justice Harlan are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
